_comment: Every Azure Resource Manager call the Arc tasks (python/arc_tasks.py, powershell/FmwArm.psm1) make. Unlike Graph, an Azure token carries no permission list: Azure RBAC decides at each call. The role every call here needs is Reader on the subscriptions or management group in scope; `actions` is the Azure RBAC action the call is checked against. Sources: Microsoft Learn, 'Subscriptions - List' (2022-12-01), 'Resources' (Resource Graph, 2024-04-01), 'Azure permissions for Management and governance', 'Azure built-in roles for General' (Reader), accessed November 3, 2026.

calls.note: Lists the subscriptions the caller can see: those where it holds any Azure role. No role action is checked.
A Resource Graph query. It returns only the resources the caller can read; with no read access the result is empty, not an error.
